first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two inherited findings indicate that reducing signup friction and shortening onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and early activation. This most directly addresses both current regressions while avoiding the documented retention risk of promotional pricing. Verify the two most relevant source records before final commitment.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding-simplification experiment only for SMB/simple-workspace accounts, explicitly excluding complex workspaces. The verified evidence directly addresses the current completion and activation declines and shows qualified-revenue improvement in SMBs. Because signup simplification had a small retention decline and shortened onboarding increased churn in complex workspaces, monitor 30- and 60-day retention, churn, activation, and qualified revenue; do not broadly roll out based only on early completion gains.
